request: Facilitator Reminder Email not sending — Austin Laviola (Katy Bible Church)
issue: Facilitator reminder email failed to send to Austin Laviola. Root cause: email on the event was "Austin.LaViola@katybible.org" (mixed case) but the registered email in Users table is "austin.laviola@katybible.org" (lowercase). Case mismatch caused the automation to fail to find the user, resulting in no portal link being generated.
notes: Email case sensitivity issue. The "Update New Portal Facilitator Magic Link in Events" automation does an exact match on email — capitalization differences will cause it to fail silently. Fixed by correcting the email on the event to match the Users table exactly.

issue: Meal plan location defaulting to "Dining" instead of "Lodge" for events held at the Lodge. The script converts the "Hotel" facility to "Dining," which doesn't account for events that need a Lodge meal location.
notes: Meal plan location defaults to Dining when facility is set to Hotel. Location can be manually updated per meal. Proposed fix: add a Meal Location field on the event to give coordinators more control. Pending client approval.

issue: Deleting a meeting room reservation was not syncing with the Room Assignments on the event. Duplicate reservations were also not being handled correctly when deleting.
notes: Built a reverse sync — deleting a reservation now automatically updates Room Assignments. Duplicate reservations are handled: deleting one keeps the room assignment until the last reservation is removed. Removing a room from Room Assignments clears all its reservations.

issue: "Request limit exceeded" error appearing intermittently while loading the portal. Able to continue working but error keeps coming up.

Also found "New Hotel Room Assignment - Sync Hotel Rooms Table" automation running 3,795 times this month — was triggering for Availability records unnecessarily. Fixed by adding conditional logic: If Type is Event. This reduces unnecessary API calls going forward. Platform limitation — nothing further can be done without migration.
